package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"html"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/analytics"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/viz"
	"github.com/geoffmilleraz/app-kit/appkit/ui/vizframe"
)

var now = time.Date(2026, 9, 22, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

func dataset(kind string) analytics.Dataset {
	small, large, zero := 1.0, 10.0, 0.0
	if kind == "spread" {
		large = 1e12
	}
	return analytics.Dataset{
		Contract: analytics.Contract{
			ID: "resolution-" + kind, Title: "Synthetic value comparison", Unit: "items", Decimals: 0,
			Grain: "selected synthetic row", Aggregation: "one observation per row",
			Window:       analytics.Window{Kind: analytics.SnapshotWindow, Start: now, TimeZone: "UTC"},
			Source:       vizframe.Derived("Fixed synthetic resolution fixture; no real data."),
			Freshness:    analytics.Freshness{ObservedAt: now, MaxAge: time.Hour},
			Completeness: analytics.Partial, CoverageNote: "One selected observation is missing.",
			Uncertainty: "Synthetic exact values; no inference.",
		},
		Rows: []analytics.Row{
			{ID: "small", Label: "Small", Value: &small},
			{ID: "large", Label: "Large", Value: &large},
			{ID: "zero", Label: "Zero", Value: &zero},
			{ID: "missing", Label: "Missing", MissingReason: "Not observed"},
		},
		Legend: []analytics.LegendItem{{Role: "accent", Label: "Measured quantity"}},
	}
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		log.Fatal("one explicit CSS path required")
	}
	css, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	origin := "http://" + listener.Addr().String()
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Host != strings.TrimPrefix(origin, "http://") || (r.Method != "GET" && r.Method != "HEAD") {
			http.Error(w, "refused", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		if r.URL.Path == "/app.css" {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
			_, _ = w.Write(css)
			return
		}
		kind, scheme := r.URL.Query().Get("case"), r.URL.Query().Get("theme")
		if (kind != "spread" && kind != "readable") || (scheme != "light" && scheme != "dark") {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		d := dataset(kind)
		if r.URL.Path == "/export.csv" {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/csv; charset=utf-8")
			w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", `attachment; filename="resolution.csv"`)
			if err := analytics.WriteCSV(w, d, now); err != nil {
				log.Print(err)
			}
			return
		}
		if r.URL.Path != "/" {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		body, err := analytics.RenderBars(d, viz.BarsOptions{}, now)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "render refused", 500)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		fmt.Fprintf(w, `<!doctype html><html lang="en" data-theme="%s"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Analytical resolution fixture</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/app.css"></head><body class="bg-surface text-ink p-4"><main class="mx-auto max-w-4xl"><h1 class="mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold">Analytical resolution fixture</h1>%s<a class="underline" href="/export.csv?case=%s&amp;theme=%s">Export identical values</a></main></body></html>`, scheme, body, html.EscapeString(kind), scheme)
	})
	fmt.Println("READY " + origin)
	log.Fatal((&http.Server{Handler: mux, ReadHeaderTimeout: 3 * time.Second}).Serve(listener))
}
